scope.contract: Incremental request-line parser over r->header_in; returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, or an NGX_HTTP_PARSE_* rejection and retains r->state between calls.
scope.preconditions: An nginx HTTP request and input buffer created by ngx_http_init_connection.

scope.contract: Incremental single-header parser using r->state; returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, NGX_HTTP_PARSE_HEADER_DONE, or an invalid-header code.
scope.preconditions: A parsed request line or an upstream header buffer and configured underscore policy.

scope.contract: Normalizes a previously parsed complex URI into r->uri; returns NGX_OK or NGX_ERROR.
scope.preconditions: Request-line parser populated uri_start/uri_end and flags; request pool and output URI storage are valid.

scope.contract: Stateful chunk framing parser; updates ngx_http_chunked_t and returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, or NGX_ERROR while callers consume payload.
scope.preconditions: Zeroed/preserved chunk context and a bounded buffer whose pos/last are maintained by the real HTTP body path.

scope.contract: Incremental upstream HTTP status parser; returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, or NGX_ERROR and fills ngx_http_status_t.
scope.preconditions: A live proxy upstream request and reply buffer supplied by the adapter.

scope.contract: Consumes one complete PROXY v1/v2 header and returns the first byte after it, or NULL on rejection; stores parsed metadata in c->proxy_protocol.
scope.preconditions: Connection log and pool are valid; buf..last is one contiguous candidate header (not a streaming contract).
scope.reachability: The embedded upstream listener has no proxy_protocol parameter, so this function requires a measured follow-up target if coverage remains zero.
